obligations.text: A correction requires a Correction Authorization issued by the Reliability Supervisor and a linked correction event entered by the Maintenance Records Custodian.
A change to asset, work order, inspection, approval, effective time or resulting status requires a new approval basis.
One Maintenance Register return-to-service entry for EQ-204, WO-7304, IN-552 and AP-091 requires Reliability Supervisor authority and the clerk's factual gate.
